text:
Gold Price in 2004
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2004, the LBMA gold price rose 9.0% between 2004-01-30 ($400) and 2004-12-30 ($436). The highest sampled price was $453 in November and the lowest was $389 in April. The mean of these observations was $410. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
